content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge grounds UNDERDETERMINED on C4 pressing a dropped limb and no live link remaining, not on a single verse failing to state a link or its contrary.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
